posts.author: BlankGames
posts.body:
Hello everyone. I am currently studying ICT at uni after doing 2 years of game design in college and having taken an unintentional gap year inbetween.
Ironically, I now have the passion for game dev again and want to test incorperating the stuff I will be studying in my new degree through video games as an artform, and the various passion projects I've had in my mind until this point to finally see the light of day.
I played around with the demo version of "RPG Maker WITH Player" on PS5, and I wanted to do more with my project and decided to buy on PC "RPG Maker MZ", and it's as good as I expected it to be.
My inspirations are Touhou, FF1 Pixel Remaster, and anything that gives off "dark web" vibes that makes the player feel like what they are playing is illegal/criminal, even though it's alright ethically and legally speaking technically (though I will probably explore the abyss in storytelling and such) - aka, kind of like the creepypasta game "petscop".
Here is what I have after playing around in settings for about 10 minutes after installing the engine:
Making some pixel art without any clear stroy in mind, but hopefully it works out eventually:
Edit: I decided to resign from the ICT degree before fees applied, read the 19th post on this thread for details.

posts.author: BlankGames
posts.body:
After careful consideration before the census date for the first semester of my schooling in ICT, I have decided that I will be resigning from the degree.
University is a slow pathway to where I want to be, and is really restricting when it comes to free time despite this. For crying out loud the first half year is filled up of TWO ‘integrity’ subjects, and another one on indigenous culture studies. The only relevant and good one is maths, and although I really like the teacher for that subject too, it’s not worth 60k over the course of 3 years for something I could do for $500 online for a CompTIA A+ certificate and add to my resume to learn on the job, which although it‘ll only be entry level, the same applies to a university student’s circumstance, so I’m getting out of here to skip as many middlemen as I can.
I was already working on those self studies, but put it on hold for uni, which sounds right in theory but from now experience, I can only treat uni as the distraction and the online studies as the priority.
Anyways, that means I’ll be able to also commit more time to the game! So… CAN’T WAIT FOR THAT >.<

posts.author: BlankGames
posts.body:
I got doxxed and have been going through the process of undoxxing myself in every service and email and account that I own for the past few months.
I feel like it comes from a place of paranoia, and the fact that I'm going as far as to remove the alias "blank" out of my life entirely feels like this creeping sense of blasphemy against my entire past (since it's pretty much my legitimate nickname at this point).
I've made it back to here now, wondering if I'd be going overboard if I were to decide to completely remove this account as well, if that's even possible (I know forums tend to be strict with maintaining conversation and username history).
